title: Living reviews, amendments and update lineage — agent-panel evaluation

panel_protocol.limitation: Simulation instrument only; not a substitute for live clinical review surveillance or human protocol amendment committee decisions.

inter_rater_agreement.agreement_notes: All three panel roles converged independently on approval. Convergence centered on strict human release requirements whenever record changes occur, PRISMA-LSR declared strictly as reporting scope, acyclic ancestor-bounded supersession lineage, BLAKE3 change detection, and protocol amendment version advance accountability.
convergence_vectors: Strict human release requirement forbidding automated inclusion into screening
PRISMA-LSR standard pack scoped strictly to reporting considerations
Acyclic DAG living update lineage validation with ancestor supersession
Deterministic BLAKE3 record digest calculation and change attribution
divergence_vectors: Timeline for extending PRISMA-LSR crosswalks to ongoing clinical trials
Addition of structured re-screening count tallies in amendment contracts

panel_recommendations: Retain mandatory human release invariant on all living update runs with record changes.
Preserve PRISMA-LSR scope as reporting rather than conduct across all documentation.
Maintain honest claim boundaries distinguishing synthetic multi-cycle scenario fixtures from live external review surveillance.
